hypothesis: On a live branch miss that will load an existing disk checkpoint, serializing the displaced live checkpoint is cache-admission work rather than target-model computation. A diagnostic bypass should remove its measured 0.69-0.73 second, approximately 919 MiB write without changing the selected 5,044-token checkpoint, synchronized logits, output tokens, or subsequent decode.

implementation_contract.scope: diagnostic only; bypass only the pre-load reason=evict store when live state missed and disk lookup follows
implementation_contract.required_log: one explicit diagnostic activation marker at startup and one skipped-store marker per bypass
implementation_contract.production_followup_if_probe_passes: replace the destructive diagnostic bypass with a fail-safe design that verifies a load candidate before deciding displaced-state admission, then requalify

red_test.production_path: ds4_server request cache-decision path immediately before kv_cache_try_load
requirements: unset flag preserves the existing kv_cache_store_current call
exact value 1 selects the diagnostic bypass and logs it
0, empty, and arbitrary values cannot enable the bypass; nonempty invalid values fail startup
the bypass cannot affect cold requests, live cache hits, or runs without disk KV enabled
red_test.genuine_red: compile and execute ds4_server_test against unchanged engine source; failure must be the missing selector behavior, not a missing file or build error

bounded_probe.fixture: the frozen 5,055-token warm request followed by the 5,066-token branch-matched append and 160-token exact replay
required_checks: OFF performs exactly one reason=evict store and ON performs zero
ON emits exactly one diagnostic skipped-store marker
both select the same authenticated 5,044-token checkpoint
all three synchronized logit tensors are byte-identical across arms
output token IDs and generated UTF-8 bytes are identical
ON warm append wall time is at least 0.5 seconds lower than OFF
subsequent decode throughput ON/OFF ratio is at least 0.99 in the bounded falsifier
no OOM, Xid, swap growth, timeout, identity drift, or surviving descendant; minimum MemAvailable at least 10 GiB
bounded_probe.interpretation: PASS only justifies production-safe implementation work; it does not promote the diagnostic flag or change the serving profile

nll_gate: not applicable because target computation and outputs must remain byte-identical
review: same persistent Nash and Singer reviewers; no engine run until the frozen implementation has no critical or high findings
